sections.title: Form
sections.text: Pistacia vera, the pistachio tree, is a deciduous tree that can grow to about 10 m. Its leaves are pinnate and its flowers are small and borne in clusters.

sections.title: Fruit and food
sections.text: Each fruit is a drupe containing one oval seed. The edible kernel is the pistachio sold as a food; the fruit is harvested as it ripens.
